focus: Middle-end analyses: SSA construction (heritage.cc/hh), prototype recovery (coreaction.cc, fspec.hh), stack/deadcode management (varmap.cc, rangeutil.cc), decision points and feedback loops

pipeline.name: Heritage (SSA Construction) - Pass 0+
pipeline.description: Builds Static Single Assignment form in multiple passes. Each pass heritages one or more address spaces, converting free Varnodes into linked SSA form. Performs phi-node (MULTIEQUAL) placement and renaming algorithm on specified address space.
pipeline.inputs: free Varnodes, control-flow graph, LocationMap tracking previously heritaged ranges, HeritageInfo per address space with delay/deadcodedelay
pipeline.outputs: new Varnode instances linking, MULTIEQUAL ops for merge points, updated globaldisjoint coverage map, pass counter incremented

pipeline.name: Deadcode Delay Management (Feedback Loop Mechanism)
pipeline.description: Controls when dead code removal is safe by delaying removals until all Varnodes for a space have been heritaged. When new Varnodes appear after deadcode removal, bumps delay and triggers restart.
pipeline.inputs: deadremoved flag per HeritageInfo, current pass number, detected Varnodes appearing after heritage
pipeline.outputs: deadcodedelay incremented (bumpDeadcodeDelay), setRestartPending flag set, deadRemovalAllowed gate function

pipeline.name: Phi-node (MULTIEQUAL) Placement Algorithm
pipeline.description: Determines which control-flow merge points need MULTIEQUAL operations based on dominance frontier. Uses augmented dominator tree and priority-queued work-list by dominator depth.
pipeline.inputs: writevars: Varnodes written in blocks, readvars: Varnodes read, control-flow dominance tree, PriorityQueue(block,depth)
pipeline.outputs: merge vector populated with blocks needing MULTIEQUAL, new MULTIEQUAL ops inserted at block entries

pipeline.name: Renaming / SSA Link Phase
pipeline.description: Propagates data-flow definitions up the dominator tree via variable stacks. Links each Varnode use to its definition; populates MULTIEQUAL inputs with defined Varnodes.
pipeline.inputs: MULTIEQUAL ops placed, VariableStack (per disjoint address range), dominator tree structure
pipeline.outputs: each non-input Varnode linked to defining PcodeOp, MULTIEQUAL inputs populated with defined Varnodes

pipeline.name: Load/Store Guard Range Analysis
pipeline.description: Detects LOAD ops reading from dynamically indexed locations and STORE ops to stack; creates guard logic and refines ranges via value-set analysis with three states (unanalyzed -> partial -> locked).
pipeline.inputs: LOAD/STORE PcodeOps, discovered indexed stack pointers, ValueSetSolver for range determination
pipeline.outputs: LoadGuard/StoreGuard list, range bounds (minimumOffset, maximumOffset, step), INDIRECT ops created if needed

pipeline.name: Stack Pointer Flow Analysis (ActionStackPtrFlow, StackSolver)
pipeline.description: Solves linear equations over stack-pointer references to determine extrapop (stack changes across calls). Propagates solutions via companion indices for underdetermined systems.
pipeline.inputs: stack-pointer Varnode references, CPUI_ADD/COPY/INDIRECT ops linking them, spacebase register data
pipeline.outputs: extrapop values filled in for each call, equations propagated via constraint solver

pipeline.name: Prototype Recovery - Parameter Discovery (ActionActiveParam, ParamTrial system)
pipeline.description: Discovers function call input parameters through trial list accumulation and ancestral use analysis. Data-flow based; repeated passes narrow down which putative inputs are actually used. Trial progression: active -> checked -> used.
pipeline.inputs: FuncCallSpecs with input Varnodes (trials), AliasChecker for stack aliasing, maxpass threshold per call
pipeline.outputs: ParamTrial.isUsed() flags set, trials finalized once numpasses >= maxpass

pipeline.name: Prototype Recovery - Return Value Discovery (ActionReturnRecovery)
pipeline.description: Determines function return values by analyzing CPUI_RETURN ops via ancestral use validation. Similar trial-based approach to parameters but applied to outputs. Generates PIECE ops for multi-piece returns.
pipeline.inputs: CPUI_RETURN ops, ParamActive output trials, AncestorRealistic validator for use plausibility
pipeline.outputs: return CPUI_RETURN inputs modified with concatenations (PIECE ops) if multiple pieces

pipeline.name: Function Linkage Setup (ActionFuncLink, ActionFuncLinkOutOnly)
pipeline.description: Establishes formal input/output Varnode structures for called functions. For locked prototypes, creates exact Varnodes; for unknown, initializes ParamActive trial system.
pipeline.inputs: FuncCallSpecs proto (locked or guessed), sub-function Funcdata if available
pipeline.outputs: input/output Varnodes created matching prototype, ParamActive trials initialized if recovery enabled

pipeline.name: Dead Code Elimination (ActionDeadCode, consume bit propagation)
pipeline.description: Marks and removes Varnodes that are never consumed. Uses bit-level consume propagation backward from sinks (branches, returns, calls); gates on deadRemovalAllowed() per address space to avoid removing before heritage completes.
pipeline.inputs: all Varnodes and ops, deadRemovalAllowed per space, consume bits, autoLive marks on branches/returns
pipeline.outputs: unconsumed PcodeOps destroyed/output unset, dead Varnodes queued for cleanup, seenDeadcode(spc) called

pipeline.name: Stack Frame Restructuring (ActionRestructureVarnode, ScopeLocal.restructure)
pipeline.description: Maps stack locations to symbols by collecting RangeHint data-type hints and resolving conflicts via heuristic scoring. Iteratively refines stack frame layout.
pipeline.inputs: Varnodes on stack space, load guards, symbol metadata, RangeHint collection from varnodes/pointers
pipeline.outputs: symbols created/updated on stack, RangeHint conflicts resolved via preferred() heuristics (typelock > rangeType > type specificity)

pipeline.name: Value-Set Analysis (ValueSetSolver, CircleRange pullBack/pushForward)
pipeline.description: Computes abstract ranges of values reachable to each Varnode using weak-topological-order iteration with controlled widening. Supports constraint generation from branches for range refinement.
pipeline.inputs: source Varnodes (roots), sinks (targets), conditional branch constraints, Widener strategy (WidenerFull: iter 2,5 or WidenerNone: iter 3)
pipeline.outputs: ValueSet per Varnode (range, typeCode for spacebase-relative), ValueSetRead at each operation use point

pipeline.name: Type Inference (ActionInferTypes, propagateTypeEdge)
pipeline.description: Propagates data-type information across data-flow edges iteratively. Handles feedback with ActionRestructure over spacebase-relative pointers; includes iteration limit to prevent hangs on circular struct pointers.
pipeline.inputs: initial Varnode types from operations, spacebase references to local map, recursion depth limit (arbitrary, line 972)
pipeline.outputs: narrowed Datatype on each Varnode, may trigger ActionRestructure re-run if spacebase types change

pipeline.name: Constant Pointer Resolution (ActionConstantPtr, space inference heuristics)
pipeline.description: Detects constants that represent addresses and marks them as pointers. Decision: explicit space attributes > usage context inference.
pipeline.inputs: constant Varnodes, space attribute inference heuristic, symbol address ranges
pipeline.outputs: Varnode marked as pointer, underlying symbol reference established

pipeline.name: Determined Branch Simplification (ActionDeterminedBranch, value-set use)
pipeline.description: Removes conditional branches whose condition Varnode is determined to be constant, using value-set analysis results.
pipeline.inputs: CBRANCH ops with constant-valued conditions (from value-set analysis)
pipeline.outputs: redundant CBRANCH ops removed, control flow simplified

feedback_loops.name: Heritage Re-triggering on New Varnodes After Deadcode
feedback_loops.trigger: New free Varnode detected after dead code removal in collect phase (LocationMap detects address previously thought heritaged but Varnode re-appears)
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Heritage main loop (heritage.cc:2663); entire function decompilation restarts with bumped deadcodedelay
feedback_loops.mechanism: Lines 2712-2730 detect prev==2 (fully contained in old) or partial overlap with deadremoved>0. Call bumpDeadcodeDelay(vn->getSpace()) which invokes fd->getOverride().insertDeadcodeDelay(...+1) and setRestartPending(true). Decompiler harness restarts function from beginning.

feedback_loops.name: Type Propagation Feedback Loop with Stack Restructuring
feedback_loops.trigger: ActionInferTypes discovers new types for spacebase-relative pointers; these affect struct layouts learned by ActionRestructureVarnode
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: ActionRestructureVarnode runs again to rebuild symbol layout with new type information
feedback_loops.mechanism: When spacebase-relative pointer type changes, propagateSpacebaseRef(data, vn) updates local map struct types. ActionRestructure marks entries dirty (numpass incremented, coreaction.cc:870). Comment at lines 968-970 acknowledges feedback loop; arbitrary iteration limit (line 972) prevents infinite loop.

feedback_loops.name: ParamActive Trial Refinement Across Multiple Passes
feedback_loops.trigger: checkInputTrialUse detects active use of a trial Varnode in data-flow not confirmed in prior pass (or marks trial inactive if no use found)
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: ActionActiveParam applied again in next action iteration (not a full decompile restart, but action-level restart)
feedback_loops.mechanism: finishPass increments numpasses. If numpasses < maxpass and checkInputTrialUse found changes, count+=1 signals continue. Only when numpasses >= maxpass does markFullyChecked prevent re-entry. coreaction.cc:1774-1777 shows: if !isFullyChecked() -> count+=1 (retry).

feedback_loops.name: Load Guard Range Refinement via ValueSetSolver
feedback_loops.trigger: analyzeNewLoadGuards invokes ValueSetSolver to narrow guard range bounds from unanalyzed -> partial -> locked state
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Potentially heritage if guard ranges change significantly (affects MULTIEQUAL/INDIRECT placement), but typically localized to load guard analysis
feedback_loops.mechanism: LoadGuard.analysisState progresses 0(unanalyzed)->1(partial)->2(locked) via establishRange/finalizeRange. ValueSetSolver computes value ranges at pointer definitions. If locked range is much smaller than initial [0, max], may invalidate prior alias assumptions, but no explicit re-heritage trigger (heritage.cc:2753 processes guards post-heritage).

feedback_loops.name: Call Prototype Locking Invalidates Recovery Trials
feedback_loops.trigger: User (or inference) locks a call's prototype (isInputLocked=true) after ParamActive trials begin
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: ActionFuncLink re-runs; trial system is abandoned in favor of locked prototype specification
feedback_loops.mechanism: In ActionActiveParam.apply (line 1768), check isInputActive(). If proto becomes locked between passes, isInputActive() may become false, causing function to skip trial processing and finalize from locked proto. coreaction.cc:1768-1784 shows: if (!fc->isInputActive()) skip trial processing.

feedback_loops.name: Extrapop Determination Triggers INDIRECT Placeholder Resolution
feedback_loops.trigger: ActionStackPtrFlow solves StackSolver equations for unknown extrapop values at calls
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Varnode.resolveSpacebaseRelative called to finalize/fold INDIRECT ops after extrapop known
feedback_loops.mechanism: INDIRECT ops are inserted at call sites with unknown extrapop (ActionExtraPopSetup). Once ActionStackPtrFlow determines value via StackSolver.solve(), INDIRECT is replaced with COPY/ADD or resolved. coreaction.cc:95 checks checkClog and repair functions.

decision_points.name: Refinement Decision: Fragment Large Ranges
decision_points.decision: If memory range size > 4 and collected reads don't cover full size (max < size), split range at gaps via refinement(). Otherwise, treat as single range for MULTIEQUAL placement. Heuristic: coarse 4-byte threshold.
decision_points.alternatives: Keep unsplit -> may place MULTIEQUALs covering unused bytes, slower narrowing; split aggressively -> more precise MULTIEQUALs but more refined ranges to process
decision_points.current_override: Hard threshold of 4 bytes (line 2610: if size > 4 && max < size)

decision_points.name: Deadcode Delay Bump Decision
decision_points.decision: If new Varnode detected at address previously heritaged and deadremoved>0 for that space, should we bump deadcodedelay (restart pipeline) or ignore? Criterion: detection of prev==2 or partial overlap with deadremoved flag set.
decision_points.alternatives: Bump (current) -> restarts, safe but slow; ignore -> faster but risks incomplete analysis if more Varnodes appear later

decision_points.name: Trial Finalization Threshold in ParamActive
decision_points.decision: After numpasses iterations, decide if trials are 'fully checked'. Criterion: numpasses >= maxpass. If so, call resolveModel + buildInputFromTrials to finalize. Otherwise, count+=1 to schedule retry.
decision_points.alternatives: Conservative (higher maxpass, e.g., 10) -> more passes, better accuracy but slower; aggressive (lower maxpass, e.g., 2) -> faster but less certain of parameters
decision_points.current_override: maxpass set per function prototype model; defaults visible in code appear to be low (~5-10 based on comment patterns), encourages multiple passes

decision_points.name: RangeHint Conflict Resolution via preferred()
decision_points.decision: When two RangeHints overlap, which data-type to keep? Multi-tier priority: (1) typelock > unlocked, (2) fixed > open, (3) type specificity (typeOrder).
decision_points.alternatives: Simple first-fit -> keeps old, misses better types; last-fit -> keeps new, may lose locks; by size -> may prefer wrong type; by frequency -> may bias common types
decision_points.current_override: Multi-tier heuristic hardcoded; typelock is absolute override, then rangeType, then type::typeOrder

decision_points.name: ValueSet Widening Iteration Timing
decision_points.decision: When iteration doesn't stabilize, apply widening at iteration N. If still not converged, apply full-range at iteration M. Widener strategy chosen at call site. Heuristic: balance precision vs. convergence speed.
decision_points.alternatives: WidenerFull (early widen) -> converges faster, less precise; WidenerNone (freeze early) -> captures initial values, shows step; no widening -> may not converge; late widening -> more precise but slower
decision_points.anchor: rangeutil.hh:240-261 (WidenerFull, default: widenIteration=2, fullIteration=5), 254-261 (WidenerNone, default: freezeIteration=3)
decision_points.current_override: WidenerFull uses fixed iteration numbers (2, 5); WidenerNone freezes at 3. Called from heritage.cc:151 (LoadGuard analysis)

decision_points.name: Constant-to-Address Interpretation Decision
decision_points.decision: Given a constant Varnode, interpret as pointer or integer? Priority: (1) searchForSpaceAttribute (explicit annotation), (2) selectInferSpace (usage context heuristic).
decision_points.alternatives: Only explicit annotations -> miss inferred pointers; only inference -> may misclassify; mixed (current) -> balances annotation strength with inference
decision_points.current_override: Two-tier: space attribute > inference heuristic (selectInferSpace chooses best match from space list by operand types)

decision_points.name: Prototype Model Resolution (Recovery vs. Default)
decision_points.decision: For unknown call proto, enable ParamActive recovery (slow, iterative) or apply default model (fast, conservative)? Criterion: presence of protorecovery action group.
decision_points.alternatives: Recovery enabled -> iterative refinement, higher quality, slower; recovery disabled -> ActionFuncLinkOutOnly (output-only) -> fast but may miss inputs
decision_points.current_override: Conditional on action group: if protorecovery in action list, enable; else fall back to FuncLinkOutOnly (seen in action list construction, coreaction.cc line 5646)

decision_points.name: Return Value Ancestral Use Validation Depth
decision_points.decision: For a return value in a trial, does CPUI_RETURN truly consume it or is it vacuous/dead? Use AncestorRealistic validator + ancestorOpUse(maxancestor, ...) depth check. Heuristic: realistic ancestor patterns + recursion limit.
decision_points.alternatives: Strict validation (low maxancestor) -> misses some valid returns; loose (high maxancestor) -> includes dead returns; no validation -> accepts all
decision_points.current_override: maxancestor = data.getArch()->trim_recurse_max (architecture-wide setting); AncestorRealistic.execute validates op type

decision_points.name: Input Type Propagation Iteration Limit
decision_points.decision: Type propagation depth-first can loop on struct fields with circular pointers. Apply arbitrary iteration limit and warn. Heuristic: prevent hangs without affecting most functions.
decision_points.alternatives: No limit -> hangs on cycles; tight limit -> incomplete types; adaptive limit (per function complexity) -> complex heuristic; current -> simple, reliable
decision_points.current_override: Arbitrary iteration limit mentioned (line 972: 'Arbitrary iteration limit') but constant not visible in header; warning issued if exceeded

intervention_surfaces.name: deadcodedelay Override
intervention_surfaces.description: Per-address-space override to set delay before dead code removal allowed. Set via fd->getOverride().insertDeadcodeDelay(spc, newdelay). Prevents premature dead code removal before all Varnodes heritaged.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Heritage deadRemovalAllowed(spc) gate returns (pass > info->deadcodedelay); if false, dead code not removed, heritage continues next pass

intervention_surfaces.name: Locked Prototypes (FuncProto input/output locks)
intervention_surfaces.description: User can mark proto input/output as locked via setInputLocked(true), disabling ParamActive trial recovery. Locks set from declared proto or user override.
intervention_surfaces.affects: ActionActiveParam checks isInputActive (skip if locked); ActionReturnRecovery (skip if output locked); coreaction.cc:1768, 1810

intervention_surfaces.name: Heritage Space Delay (per-space initial delay)
intervention_surfaces.description: Architecture/address space can specify initial heritage delay. Stack space typically has delay=1 to discover all stack Varnodes in pass 0 before linking in pass 1.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Heritage loop: pass < info->delay -> skip processing; heritage.cc:2687; allows phased discovery

intervention_surfaces.name: Widener Strategy Selection (WidenerFull vs WidenerNone)
intervention_surfaces.description: ValueSetSolver.solve(maxiter, widener) accepts Widener object; WidenerFull widens at iteration 2/5, WidenerNone freezes at 3. Affects guard range precision/convergence.
intervention_surfaces.affects: LoadGuard.analyzeNewLoadGuards invokes solver with chosen widener; determines when range stabilizes; rangeutil.hh:236-261

intervention_surfaces.name: PrototypeModel ParamList Configuration
intervention_surfaces.description: Architecture defines ParamList models (p_standard, p_register, etc.) with ParamEntry locations. Trial resolution uses these to assign slot->address mapping.
intervention_surfaces.affects: ParamActive.resolveModel() and deriveInputMap determine final parameter positions; fspec.hh:425-433

intervention_surfaces.name: AliasChecker Stack Boundaries
intervention_surfaces.description: ScopeLocal aliasChecker configurable localBoundary and localExtreme from FuncProto. Defines parameter vs. local stack regions for alias analysis.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Stack restructuring: determines which stack offsets are aliased by pointers; varmap.cc:155, varmap.hh:151-152

intervention_surfaces.name: ParamActive.maxpass (max iterations)
intervention_surfaces.description: Maximum iterations before finalizing parameter trials. Once numpasses >= maxpass, trials marked as 'fully checked' and resolved.
intervention_surfaces.affects: ActionActiveParam finalization (lines 1774-1775); controls trial analysis effort

intervention_surfaces.name: Jumptable Recovery Flag (isJumptableRecoveryOn)
intervention_surfaces.description: If true, certain heritage decisions skipped (e.g., deadcode delay bumping). Prevents restarts during jump-table-specific analysis.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Heritage lines 2714, 2723 check fd->isJumptableRecoveryOn(); if true, skips bumpDeadcodeDelay

intervention_surfaces.name: Force Restructure (Heritage.forceRestructure)
intervention_surfaces.description: Set maxdepth=-1 to force full augmented dominator tree rebuild on next heritage pass. Useful if block structure changed externally.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Heritage buildADT() re-runs at line 2677; affects phi-node placement

intervention_surfaces.name: RangeHint typelock Flag
intervention_surfaces.description: RangeHint marked typelock=true if data-type is user-locked or from locked symbol. Overrides reconciliation in preferred() heuristic.
intervention_surfaces.affects: varmap.cc preferred(): locked type always wins conflict; varmap.hh:102, varmap.cc:132-135

insights: Heritage is explicitly non-linear: deadcodedelay and bumpDeadcodeDelay mechanism detects new Varnodes post-removal and restarts entire decompilation with incremented delay. This is explicit architectural feedback, not an implicit loop.

SSA construction spans multiple per-space passes to decouple discovery (pass 0: collect all Varnodes) from linking (pass 1+: build SSA). Allows stack Varnodes (which are discovered incrementally from data-flow) to be fully collected before aggressive MULTIEQUAL/INDIRECT placement.

Phi-node placement and renaming are decoupled stages within a single heritage pass: placeMultiequals() places all MULTIEQUAL ops first for current ranges, then rename() links them. Avoids iteration within a pass.

ParamActive trial system is explicit iterative refinement: each ActionActiveParam pass checks trials for active use and marks them. Only when numpasses >= maxpass do trials finalize. This is action-level iteration, not a full decompile restart.

Type propagation over spacebase-relative pointers creates acknowledged feedback loop (coreaction.cc:968-970 comment): if struct types change, ActionRestructure re-runs, which may affect subsequent type inference. Arbitrary iteration limit (line 972) prevents infinite loop.

Value-set analysis uses explicit widening strategies (WidenerFull with fixed iterations 2,5; WidenerNone with freeze at 3) to trade precision for convergence. Not a natural fixed-point solver; widening is mandatory for termination.

Load/Store guards are two-phase: generateLoadGuard creates initial guards with full ranges [0, max]; analyzeNewLoadGuards refines ranges via ValueSetSolver post-heritage. LoadGuard.analysisState (0->1->2) tracks progression to locked state.

Deadcode removal gates on deadRemovalAllowed() per space, preventing removal before heritage completes. Restart via deadcodedelay is explicit architectural decision, triggered by detection in lines 2712-2730.

Constant-to-pointer interpretation (ActionConstantPtr) is two-tier: explicit space attributes override inference. selectInferSpace heuristic chooses best address space from symbol lists if multiple candidates.
ParamTrial slot numbering is relative to CALL input indices, not final parameter positions. Renumbering happens in resolveModel/deriveInputMap; final ordering determined by PrototypeModel ParamList.
